name: ClientInstallationOS stage change → Advance pipeline
task: When ClientInstallationOS.workflow_stage changes: if new stage is 'Ready for Install' → invoke activateAllServices with order_id. If stage is 'Complete' → send Telegram to Nolan confirming client is live + log to AgentLog. If stage is 'Failed' → Telegram Nolan with error details + set requires_nolan=true in AgentLog.
